title: What's New: Enhancements in E-Documents (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Azure Document Intelligence and PDF Processing
Demo: Deleting E-Documents and Two-Step Processing
Demo: Embedding PDF in XML Export

features.name: Delete incorrect E-documents
features.description: Users can now delete incorrect e-documents to avoid duplicates. The system can automatically recognize and remove duplicate documents.
caveats: Deleted documents may not be retrievable if coming from external service

features.name: Send E-documents via service and email simultaneously
features.description: Users can now send e-documents through a service connector and also via email to specific persons in parallel.

features.name: Multiple incoming document attachments
features.description: Multiple incoming documents can now be attached at once, rather than one by one. Users can set and attach 5, 6, 10 or more documents automatically.

features.name: Automated PDF attachments in E-documents
features.description: When sending sales invoices, the system automatically attaches the invoice PDF to the e-document. When receiving, PDFs are automatically extracted and displayed in the fact box.

features.name: Two-step processing of e-documents
features.description: Users can preview incoming electronic invoices before the system creates a purchase invoice, allowing for review and validation before processing.

features.name: Preview incoming e-documents
features.description: Users can inspect preview lines and extracted data of incoming electronic invoices before creating purchase invoices.

features.name: Extract PDF from e-documents
features.description: When receiving e-documents, the system automatically extracts PDF files from payloads and displays them in the fact box of the electronic document.

features.name: Export reminders and Finance chart
features.description: New functionality to export reminders and Finance chart information related to e-documents.

features.name: Fix unposted purchase documents
features.description: Users can recreate purchase invoices and credit memos that were accidentally deleted but still have associated electronic invoices.

features.name: Azure Document Intelligence for PDF processing
features.description: OCR service embedded in Business Central that processes PDF invoices into machine-readable format. Allows businesses to handle both electronic and PDF invoices with the same user experience.

caveats: Separate session will provide more details

features.name: Embed PDF in e-document XML export
features.description: When sending e-documents, the system can embed the invoice PDF inside the XML. Receivers using Business Central will see the printed version in the fact box.

features.name: Duplicate document automatic removal
features.description: System automatically recognizes and removes duplicate e-documents when the same type is entered multiple times.
